title: Disappointing Support for a Major Bank
body:
I switched to FAB from Wio because I wanted the security of a large bank with physical branches. While FAB is undoubtedly a big institution, their customer support is extremely disappointing.

Reaching support by phone is nearly impossible.
Complaints via email are ignored or prematurely marked as resolved without any follow-up.
There’s no way to escalate issues effectively, and requests for callbacks are simply ignored.
For such a large bank, the lack of reliable customer service is unacceptable. I expected more professionalism and responsiveness. FAB’s support experience needs urgent improvement.

title: Bad service
body:
Bad service 

I was open my bank account with condition zero balance, zero minimum, when I received card is showing “ can not use” I tried to call customer service but waiting so long that day i need to wait for 8 minutes no one pick up and not for fee my balance is finish then I search In google for closed my bank account I found “If the total balance of your account continues to remain zero or negative after 60 days from our communication, the Bank will close your account, including any linked debit card(s) and cheque book(s), without any further notice.” When I saw like that I leave it. i thought they will close my bank account automatic. No but not like I think every month I receive emails from bank they charge me AED25 and vat AED 1.25, I try to sent emails to close my bank account but no response, I decided to open mobile banking again for close my bank account then I saw my bank account negative 804, then I called customer they suggested  me go to brunch, any brunch I took taxi from DIP 1 to MOE waiting for queue 15 minute but they not help me anything they are rude and only give me number for call customer service, I really don’t understand what kind of fab service, I really be patient and positive , I  top up my phone AED 50 to call customer service again they suggested me to deposit to cover negative for closing my bank account, I decided to deposit AED 2000 and then bank deducted my money 804, I went to brunch MOE again for asking reason why fab deduct my money customer service answer me because I have negative balance and this is money bank not my money we can’t do anything, I was shock with his answer, then he give me phone to call customer service again, I top up my phone AED 50 call customer service again waiting them pick up 10 minutes, I talk to customer service he told me because I have negative balance bank charge me AED175, AED25,AED1.25 every month, even They never informed me anything but I have credit, however he said this is policy bank we can not do anything, but he will make request clarify transaction for me, accounting they will call me back maybe take time 3 days, and tell them my concern ,Monday accounting calling me to clarify he want to transfer my money back only 525, impossible right? They deducted my money 805,I don’t know what to do I was requesting AED700 back, they transfer 700 back and they deducted my money 105, whatever I can’t do everything I call customer service to close my bank they suggested me to make zero amount and I did but still couldn’t close, he told me I have to deposit money again because they have to deducted 175, 25,1.25 for October than I can close, everything so complicated, and I have to go to brunch and  brunch didn’t help me anything 

My account still open and every months they will charge me AED 175, AED25, AED1.25 even I didn’t do anything, I do my best try to close do whatever they suggested me but I couldn’t close my bank account 

They are service so bad, they didn’t help any thing 

The bank will only stole your money make you have credit even you didn’t loan any money from them

I’m so tired so close my bank account I don’t know really what I have to do I give up

وانا بمجرد تواصلي مع احد موظفي خدمة العملاء الهاتفية و حل مشكلتي سأغلق الحساب.

body: I am so much impressed by FAB's commitment to equality and inclusivity! As a foreigner from Ghana, I've experienced firsthand how they treat all customers with the same respect and professionalism, regardless of nationality. Their staff is culturally sensitive, and I've never felt like I'm being sidelined or treated differently because of my background. The bank's mobile app is also intuitive and makes managing my finances a breeze and their online banking platform is user-friendly and efficient. I'm grateful for the peace of mind that comes with knowing my accounts are in good hands. They understand that everyone deserves top-notch service and care. Kudos to FAB for setting a high standard for inclusive banking! FAB, the best bank in Dubai, United Arab Emirates😊💖💞!
